SME_ALLOW_OPEN_ENROLLMENT: `true`, `1`, `yes` or `on`: SME accepts invoker registration with no enrollment secret (role `internal`). Only for a lab with `SMO_ENROLLMENT_SECRET` unset; never in production.

SME_TOKEN_AUDIENCE.description: Audience SME requires in a client assertion for its token endpoint. Empty: `<SME_URL>/oauth2/token`. Set it when SME is published under another public URL than the one it is called by.
